Query: Give me the routes from Madrid to Barcelona that do not pass through Huesca.
Response:
```lambda-calculus
λx.route(x) ∧ starts_at(x, madrid) ∧ ends_at(x, barcelona) ∧ ¬∃y.(waypoint(y, x) ∧ waypoint(y, huesca))
```
